levelledPara.title: Warnings
levelledPara.para: These warnings apply throughout the manual. Read them before you operate the console.

warning.warningAndCautionPara: Downlink Desk cannot command a spacecraft and is not the mission team's own system. Do not use its alerts or limits to make decisions about real spacecraft hardware.

Telemetry arrives minutes to hours after a pass, and only when a volunteer station heard the satellite. A value on screen is the latest one received, not the spacecraft's state now. Check the time of the reading before you act on it.
A shelved alert does not appear in the main alert list until the shelf expires. Always give a reason that the next operator can act on, and shelve for the shortest time that makes sense.

caution.warningAndCautionPara: Every action is signed with the call sign entered at the top of the console. Enter your own call sign before you acknowledge, shelve, change limits or sign a handover, or the record will name the wrong person.
Limits suggested from data are based on the satellite's own recent history. If that history already contains a fault, the suggested limits will hide it. Review suggested limits before you save them.
The audit trail is tamper-evident, not tamper-proof. Someone with access to the server's files could rebuild the chain. Control who can log in to the server.
